messages:
Jin Park: thinking out loud — proposal for automatic variant escape when primary is saturated. idea: soft-escape to a compatible lower-cost variant only under capacity pressure, with sampling to monitor output quality. want to define API header + console toggle. thoughts?
Maria Gomez: +1 to sampling. must be per-tenant and per-region. don't want surprises for prod enterprise customers.
Samir Patel: +1. need clear metric hooks: escape_count, escape_latency_delta, quality_drop_rate. console needs breakdown by tenant and by model-variant pair.
Keisha Liu: default behavior? free/dev tiers opt-in? enterprise off by default? what does SLA say?
Jin Park: default: for free/dev tiers enable soft-escape (non-sticky) with sample=1% for quality checks; enterprise default off but allow admin override per-tenant. we also expose route header to opt-out.
Maria Gomez: what's header syntax? also telemetry privacy: we must not log prompts; store diffs / hashes only.
Samir Patel: header sketch:

``
X-Redwood-Escape: mode=soft; allow=quant-compat,small-arch; sample=0.01; sticky=false
```

ops-bot: deploy-check: console toggle flag `escape.autosteer` rollout=canary
Aria N.: UX: in Console -> Models -> Routing add 'Fallback behavior' card, show recent escapes and quality samples with small side-by-side outputs (redacted) + reason (saturation/capacity).
Tomer: routing engine: prefer local-region compatible variants; scoring = latency_penalty + cost_delta + quality_risk_score. when saturated, route to best-scoring variant, not random.
Keisha Liu: we need a kill-switch for incidents and a soft-quota threshold to avoid cascading escapes. e.g. only allow escapes when primary load > 90% and queueing > 200ms.
Samir Patel: agree; add circuit-breaker: if escaped_requests_quality_drop > 2% in last 5m, pause escapes for tenant for 15m.
Maria Gomez: rollout plan: 1) internal canary (platform teams), 2) opt-in beta tenants, 3) default for free/dev, 4) enterprise admin rollout. telemetry events and docs first.
Jin Park: action items:
- Samir: instrument metrics + circuit-breaker (ETA 2w)
- Aria: console card mockups + admin override UX (ETA 1w)
- Keisha: policy for quotas & incident kill-switch (ETA 3d)
- Maria: docs + privacy checklist (ETA 4d)

Jin Park: tagging @ops-bot to run canary once pieces ready :rocket:
ops-bot: noted — will post canary rollout announcement when flagged.
